shots.prompt: Night, a bright star over the rooftops, the lantern on the windowsill glows silver and pulses softly like a heartbeat
lines: NARRATOR
Three nights left. Tonight, the Shadow would finally speak.

shots.prompt: Mira sits on her bed at night holding the glowing lantern close, talking softly to the light inside
lines: MIRA
You showed me our star. Were you… mine all along?

shots.prompt: Close-up of the lantern: inside, the silver light swirls and forms a tiny shining star, answering yes
The bedroom window glass frosts over with silver patterns, a gentle tapping, Theo waving outside in the night
Theo outside under the street lamp at night, holding a flashlight, brave but nervous
lines: THEO
I brought a flashlight. And cookies. For courage.

shots.prompt: Mira and Theo walk across an old stone bridge over a misty river at night, the lantern glowing silver, moon above
Thick fog rolls onto the far end of the bridge, the street lamps flicker and go out one by one
From the fog the tall shadow figure in a long coat and wide-brimmed hat walks slowly toward them, face hidden in darkness
lines: SHADOW
That light does not belong to you, child.

shots.prompt: Mira on the bridge at night holds the lantern tight against her chest, scared but standing her ground
lines: MIRA
Yes, it does. It's my dream. I forgot it, but it's mine.

shots.prompt: Close on the shadow figure, under the hat brim only darkness and two faint silver points like distant stars
lines: SHADOW
Forgotten dreams are lost dreams. And lost dreams are mine to keep quiet.

shots.prompt: Theo on the bridge at night steps in front of Mira, voice shaking but brave, holding a flashlight
lines: THEO
Hey! Tall, dark and creepy! Leave her alone!

shots.prompt: The shadow raises a gloved hand, cold blue mist spreads over the bridge, frost creeping on the stones
The lantern in Mira's hands flares with brilliant silver light, a dome of star dust pushes the mist back
Mira shining in silver light, amazed and determined
lines: MIRA
It's protecting me. It remembers me!

shots.prompt: The shadow figure steps back from the silver light, its coat fraying into smoke at the edges
lines: SHADOW
Three nights, little dreamer. Then it will forget you too.

shots.prompt: The shadow dissolves into the fog, the street lamps on the bridge flicker back on one by one
Theo exhales, shaking, then laughs nervously
lines: THEO
I said creepy. I think he heard creepy.

shots.prompt: They arrive at the old library at night, the doors open by themselves with warm golden light
Elias in the archive holding a candle, grave and worried
lines: ELIAS
You met him on the bridge. I can see the frost on your coat.

shots.prompt: Mira in the archive holding the lantern, emotional
lines: MIRA
Elias, the dream is mine. It showed me our star. Why can't I remember it?

shots.prompt: Elias looks at her kindly, sad eyes behind round glasses
lines: ELIAS
Some dreams are hidden because they hold something we were not ready to feel.

shots.prompt: An empty space on a high archive shelf where one jar is missing, dust outlining a circle, a faint name plate scratched away
Elias points up at the empty shelf
lines: ELIAS
Your jar stood there for seven years. Then someone scratched out the name.

shots.prompt: Theo in the archive frowning, thinking hard
lines: THEO
The Shadow. He's been hiding it from you on purpose.

shots.prompt: The silver light inside the lantern draws a tiny shape: two hands, one big and one small, holding each other
Mira stares at the lantern, a tear rolls down her cheek, whispering
lines: MIRA
Big hands. Small hands. I think… I know whose hands those are.

shots.prompt: Wide shot of the archive, all the jars glow a little brighter together, warm and hopeful
lines: NARRATOR
Mira was one step closer to the truth. But the nights were running out.
